item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J01465","case1_error":"Omits Ted's four eaten cookies, reporting the intermediate remainder 138 instead of 134.","case2_error":"Includes John's one-hour break in his dancing time, producing 21 instead of 20.","reason":"The first omits a required consumption adjustment; the second includes explicitly excluded time in the requested total.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01466","case1_error":"Uses Jack's fill fraction, 8/12, instead of Jill's capacity divided by Jack's current apples, 24/8.","case2_error":"Reverses the remaining-washers subtraction to 16−20, incorrectly inferring a shortage despite the concluding statement of four remaining.","reason":"The first selects the wrong quantities for a capacity ratio; the second reverses the operands of the correct inventory subtraction.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01467","case1_error":"Uses the final fish count as the original count, calculating 20−4 instead of solving x+(x−4)=20.","case2_error":"Incorrectly evaluates the correctly written sum 8+12+16+4 as 30 instead of 40.","reason":"The first constructs an erroneous relation by confusing initial and final quantities; the second makes a numerical evaluation error.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01468","case1_error":"Uses 12 birds per snake instead of the stated three, calculating 360 birds rather than 90.","case2_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 30000×4 as 12000 instead of 120000.","reason":"The first substitutes the wrong rate into the relation; the second evaluates a correctly written expression incorrectly.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01469","case1_error":"Treats the 12-apple excess as the green-apple count, adding 16+12 instead of 16+(16+12).","case2_error":"Concludes 26 necklaces despite correctly calculating Latch's count as 14; no calculation supports 26.","reason":"The first misinterprets a comparative difference as a category total. The second supplies an unsupported concluding number after a correct calculation.","judgment":"different"}]}
